intro: Morgan's Plot is a desolate burial ground and crumbling chapel tucked away just behind the tower of Karazhan in Deadwind Pass. Dominated by restless undead and brooding silence, it holds the forgotten crypts and final resting places of those once tied to Medivh's domain.

sections.t: A Grave in the Shadow of the Tower
p: Nestled against the sheer rocky slopes directly behind Karazhan, Morgan's Plot is a sorrowful, overgrown cemetery centered on a ruined chapel and underground crypts. Long before the land decayed into Deadwind Pass, the estate served the burial needs of the tower's inhabitants and nearby grounds. Following the downfall of the Last Guardian, Medivh, dark energies seeped into the earth, driving away all normalcy. Today, restless unliving wander the chapel grounds, haunting the headstones of servants and historic figures alike.
